title: Can Claude replace HubSpot? 27/27 checks, 8 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a HubSpot alternative, a simple CRM with follow-up reminders, from one written spec: all 27 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 8 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:38): https://youtu.be/td7iXdUEBvQ
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/simple-crm
HubSpot pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/hubspot

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
